# MEMORANDUM OF AGREEMENT

# Between

# VERIZON NORTH INC. (NORTH CENTRAL REGION)

And

INTERNATIONAL BROTHERHOOD OF ELECTRICAL WORKERS, LOCAL 986

PENSIONS

Verizon North Inc. (North Central Region) and the International Brotherhood of Electrical Workers, Local 986 agree to modify the Plan for Hourly Employees' Pensions. Such modifications are subject to the Company's Board of Directors and the United States Department of the Treasury approvals and, therefore, the effective date of July 1, 2003 for the modifications will be contingent upon receipt of all necessary approvals.

Specific language will be prepared to modify the present Plan for Hourly Employees' Pensions to effect the following:


<table border=1 style='margin: auto; word-wrap: break-word;'><tr><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'></td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>Present</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>Effective July 1, 2003</td></tr><tr><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>Years of Accredited Service</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>Minimum</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>Minimum</td></tr><tr><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>15 but less than 20 years</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>$ 4,700</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>$ 4,900</td></tr><tr><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>20 but less than 25 years</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>$ 6,100</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>$ 6,300</td></tr><tr><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>25 but less than 30 years</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>$ 7,500</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>$ 7,800</td></tr><tr><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>30 but less than 35 years</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>$ 8,900</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>$ 9,300</td></tr><tr><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>35 but less than 40 years</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>$ 10,300</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>$ 10,700</td></tr><tr><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>40 or more years</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>$ 11,700</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>$ 12,200</td></tr></table>

If this Agreement is to be terminated, a written notice must be sent by either party to the other not less than sixty (60) days prior to any date thereafter on which such cancellation is to become effective.

This agreement shall be become effective as of October 27, 2002, and shall remain in effect until midnight October 22, 2005, and shall automatically continue in full force and effect thereafter until terminated, or amended, in accordance with the following procedure.

This Agreement may be amended or modified by either party giving written notice to the other of such desire to so amend or modify at least sixty (60) days and not more than ninety (90) days prior to the termination date set forth above. The written notice shall contain a full statement as to the amendments or modifications desired.
